What the agent can do today

  • Stability detectorCatches the loading→loaded transition; N-consecutive-match guard.
  • Subprocess Qt runnerAvoids STATUS_STACK_BUFFER_OVERRUN on teardown; survives crashes.
  • Widget tree dumpWalks QWidget tree, emits normalised UIElement JSON with bounds.
  • Web DOM walkPlaywright + getComputedStyle dumps the same shape for HTML pages.
  • Normalized schemaid / kind / bounds / text / class_name / children / raw — cross-platform.
  • Region-aware diffPer-element pixel %, SSIM, CIE Lab ΔE, blended quality 0-100.
  • Style snapshotfont_size, weight, family, color_fg, color_bg, padding, margin, opacity…
  • Style-mismatch notesAuto-flags font / colour / padding / opacity drift in plain English.
  • Position drift notes'pos off by (+6, -42)' — separate from size mismatch.
  • Text content diffsrc=='Run' vs tgt=='▶ Run' surfaced explicitly.
  • Bounds clippingCropping clips to screenshot bounds — no more spurious overflows.
  • Tile grid overlayPer-region [src | tgt | delta] image, top-12 worst regions.
  • 2-pane page overlayFull-page comparison with diff-coloured rectangles.
  • Interactive HTML reportSelf-contained, sortable, filterable, offline-viewable.
  • AdapterBase ABCDocumented contract for adding new platforms.
  • CLI entrypointpython -m core.ui_agent compare --source-adapter qt …
  • Multi-platformQt + Web today; UIA / Flutter slot in as 200-line adapters.
  • FAST_LOAD envSkips AgentsPage's 4 s loader so the tree walk catches the splitter.
  • READMEArchitecture, normalised contract, metrics table, examples.

Architecture (TL;DR)

Cross-platform: one diff core, many platform adapters. Adding a new platform means writing one ~200-line file under core/ui_agent/adapters/ — the diff, report, CLI, and HTML output are all platform-blind.

core/ui_agent/
  __init__.py
  __main__.py        CLI: python -m core.ui_agent compare ...
  schema.py          UIElement / Bounds / CaptureResult contract
  diff.py            region_diff + SSIM + ΔE + quality_score
  agent.py           orchestration: capture → diff → reports
  html_report.py     self-contained interactive HTML
  README.md          architecture + how to add a platform
  adapters/
    __init__.py      AdapterBase ABC
    qt_adapter.py    boots Qt MainWindow, walks QWidget tree
    _qt_subprocess_runner.py
    web_adapter.py   Playwright DOM walk + getComputedStyle

What's left for tomorrow

The agent could now drive further replica fixes mechanically. The top remaining items in the report (open FINAL_agent_report.html for the live sortable view):

  • FlowTitle — position drift +10 px, font_size 20pt mismatch with target's 16px (style fix in v14).
  • SandboxBadge / BridgeBadge — pos off by ~+185 px X: my badges are inside the LocationRow flexbox; in the source they belong to ProjectStrip with different layout math.
  • Flow buttons — pos drift in X (+/-10) because of my flex spacer; pin them to absolute positions matching source bounds.
  • AppTitle — container is 270 wide vs source 128; centering math is off.
  • AgentTeamCanvas — 35 % diff because my agent nodes don't have the elaborate halos / pulse particles the Qt canvas paints; need to read _paint_nodes rendering code.
  • Anonymous element pairing — there's a _fuzzy_pair function in diff.py ready to wire in: matches unnamed elements by class+bounds proximity. Would surface another ~30 regions.
